title: The War Horn of the Barbarians
summary: Ye Fan storms a Divine Spirit Valley branch that is slaughtering people who won't submit. Zi Tianfeng isn't there, so he wipes out the garrison and has the survivors spread his challenge: every enemy should come to Nanling. At the Wang clan, Wang Chengtian (Immortal Platform 2nd Heaven, 9th level) swears a blood oath to avenge the beheaded family head. Among the barbarians, Dongfang Man explains that only the Qiongtian war horn in the abyss can wake the whole scattered tribe, and he leads volunteers to blow it through a blood sacrifice at the ancestral land. Meanwhile the Wang army sweeps into the barbarian heartland with its sacred weapon, the damaged Purple Gold Hammer. Ye Fan lures them into an ambush, Li Tian and Yan Yixi join the fight, and Ye Fan faces Wang Chengtian and a hundred thousand Wang cavalry. The Goddess Furnace is brought out against the hammer while the blood sacrifice starts to work and a barbarian Azure Dragon Elder appears.

changes: The old summary had Ye Fan leading a barbarian army north in a surprise strike. In EP173 the Wang army invades the barbarian lands and Ye Fan defends them; the march north is EP174.
Added the Divine Spirit Valley branch raid, Wang Chengtian's oath and the war horn.
